title: Fulcra Brings Universal Multiplayer to Any Agents You Choose
summary: Fulcra Dynamics announces universal multiplayer capabilities for AI agents, enabling agent-to-agent collaboration across different AI models without vendor lock-in. The solution addresses the current limitation where AI agents can only communicate within their own ecosystem, providing a universal context backend for multi-agent interaction.
problem_solved: Eliminates AI agent ecosystem silos by enabling seamless communication and collaboration between agents regardless of their underlying AI model or platform.
why_valuable: Breaks down the 'Instinct-to-Instinct' barrier that limits current AI agent ecosystems, allowing users to leverage the best agents across different platforms without being locked into a single vendor.
